why: An outpost Defend's loss budget is priced as it commits and only a re-form re-prices it, so its losses past the budget end it: our bot in three mutually hostile seats, where alpha camps the exit beta's E18S6 Defend enters by. On the old rule every death re-priced the budget to losses so far plus the predicted dead, so the bound was never crossed: beta's Defend opened t4631 (priced a win losing 1) counted 52 lost (about 15 bodies dead, the rest spent bodies healed and drafted again) by t5355, its casts walking in one at a time.
